// Format email HTML const data = $input.first().json; const { metrics, sortedCategories, missingReceipts, monthName } = data; const sheetsUrl = `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${$env.GOOGLE_SHEETS_FINANCE_ID}`; const emailHtml = `

${monthName} Finance Report

Summary

Revenue: $${metrics.totalRevenue.toFixed(2)}
Expenses: $${metrics.totalExpenses.toFixed(2)}
Stripe Fees: $${metrics.totalStripeFees.toFixed(2)}
Net Profit: $${metrics.netProfit.toFixed(2)} (${metrics.profitMargin}%)

Top Expense Categories

    ${sortedCategories.slice(0, 5).map(cat => `
  1. ${cat.name}: $${cat.total.toFixed(2)} (${cat.percentage}%)
    2. ` ).join('')}

Action Items

  • ${missingReceipts.count} receipts still missing (total $${missingReceipts.total.toFixed(2)})

View Full Report in Google Sheets

`; return [{ json: { ...data, emailHtml, emailSubject: `${monthName} Finance Report - $${metrics.netProfit.toFixed(2)} Profit` } }];
